exercises.why: **предложил** — предложи́ть (perfective): to offer, to proffer; to propose, to suggest, to proposition. Wiktionary: пред- + ложи́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.why: **предложения** — предложе́ние: offer; suggestion, proposal (also: marriage proposal), proposition; (commerce) supply; (parliamentary action) motion. Wiktionary: предложи́ть + -е́ние.

exercises.why: **ложусь** — ложи́ться (imperfective): to lie down; to fall, to cover (of snow, etc.). Wiktionary: ложи́ть + -ся.
